# #1691: Patch: a failed first read offers Try again on the screens that still dead-end
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Most screens that can't load already offer 'Try again'. A handful still show a bare error and force you to leave and come back — or just sit dead: the online-games list when your account read fails, the deck screen's own account read, the collection's cards/wallet/XP-track/cosmetics panels, the practice screen's saved decks and custom cards, a co-op game's replay, the share-with-a-friend panel, and the friends lists. The invite screen retries but ignores the 'wait N seconds' a rate limit asks for, and a spectator can't force a reconnect during the wait the way a player already can. After this they all offer the same Try again, with the same countdown the sign-in gate uses.

## Why

- `useAccount` returns `retry`/`retryAfterMs` and `GateError` (`apps/web/src/main.tsx`) is the reference — but `routes/replays.tsx`, `routes/decks.tsx` render bare alerts, and `routes/invite.tsx` retries without the countdown.
- `routes/collection.tsx`'s `useRead`/`Section` fails five reads permanently while `QuestsPanel` on the same screen retries.
- `routes/practice.tsx` latches `useSavedDecks`/`useLobbyCatalog` failure and discards `useCustomCards`'s existing `reload`.
- `duos/DuosReplay.tsx` is the only replay surface without the conditional Try again the other two replay screens offer.
- `together/ShareReplay.tsx`, `together/TogetherRoute.tsx`'s friends panel and `together/InMatchChat.tsx` already destructure but discard `reload`s; `together/WatchRoute.tsx` offers its retry only after all auto-attempts run out while `routes/match.tsx` offers 'Reconnect now' during the wait.

## Proposal

Extract `GateError`'s inner content (message + countdown + disabled Try again) into a shared `AccountError`; add `attempt`/retry to `useRead`+`Section` and `useSavedDecks`; pass `custom.reload` into `PracticeSetup`; give `DuosReplay`'s failure branch the same conditional Try again (`reason === 'error'` only); wire the discarded reloads in `TogetherRoute`/`InMatchChat`; honor `retryAfterMs` on invite; offer 'Reconnect now' during a watcher's reconnect wait once a view exists. One small commit per screen.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/{main.tsx,net/gate.ts,routes/{replays,decks,invite,collection,practice}.tsx,practice/PracticeSetup.tsx,duos/DuosReplay.tsx,together/{ShareReplay,TogetherRoute,InMatchChat,WatchRoute}.tsx}` plus their test files. Spec §9.4, R192, §13.9, §14.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each listed surface retries a transient failure in place, with a jsdom test per surface.
- [ ] Rate-limited retries stay disabled through the countdown everywhere, including `/invite`.
- [ ] Refusals that can't change (expired/missing replay) still show no Try again.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `typecheck` green; presentation-only, no `legalActions` or hidden-info changes.

## Size and risks

Medium — about fourteen files, one repeated small pattern. Retry storms are bounded by each hook's existing single-flight guard; polling cadences unchanged.
